prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from directory listings alone. A reasonable next step is to interview **two or three** Pleasanton-area injury attorneys and compare who will actually handle your case, their experience with cases like yours, and their fee terms.

Local options to include in your calls:
- **Duncan Law Firm, P.C.** — Pleasanton; its profile lists car accidents among its practice areas and includes client reviews describing accident cases. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94588-ca-david-duncan-4469491.html)
- **The Kline Simon Law Firm** — Pleasanton; its profile lists car accidents and personal injury. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94566-ca-paulo-klinesimon-3563765.html)
- **Stephen M. Fuerch** — Pleasanton; his firm advertises car-accident representation and a free case evaluation. [Firm page](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/practice-areas/personal-injury/car-accidents/)
- **Venardi Zurada** — serves Pleasanton and the Tri-Valley and advertises free consultations. [Firm page](https://www.vzlawfirm.com/pleasanton/personal-injury-lawyer/)

These are **starting points, not endorsements**; online ratings and firm claims don’t establish who is right for your case. Before hiring, verify each lawyer’s current license and any public discipline through the [State Bar of California](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch), and ask:

1. Who will be my day-to-day contact, and will you personally handle the case?
2. What similar car-accident cases have you handled, including cases that went to trial?
3. What percentage is the contingency fee, and what case costs could I owe if there’s no recovery?
4. How will medical bills, liens, and any settlement offer be handled?

Don’t rush to sign or accept an insurer’s settlement before you understand your injuries and the agreement. If you tell me how serious your injuries are, whether fault is disputed, and whether an insurer has made an offer, I can help you narrow down what kind of attorney to look for.
